newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN IPSO-ILG SHARES OFFER CLOSES EARLY.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN IPSO-ILG SHARES OFFER CLOSES EARLY.

text.p: The initial public offering of 424,000 shares in Belgian industrial laundry equipment maker IPSO-ILG has closed early, the company said on Wednesday.
The issue had been due to close on June 20.
IPSO-ILG had announced last week it had also successfully placed 636,000 shares with institutional investors.

In total the company has sold 960,000 existing shares and 100,000 new shares priced at 1,500 francs each. It said it would announce how the offer had been allocated on June 21. It is first due to trade on the Brussels Stock Exchange on June 27.

ISPO-ILG had an operating profit in 1995/96 of 328 million francs on sales of 2.5 billion francs. The company is divided into three main divisions, two based in Belgium the other, Cissell, in Kentucky, U.S.
